result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out. The main defect is the promo banner, whose white text on a pale mint background is nearly unreadable. There are also a couple of minor visual inconsistencies in the restaurant cards.

issues.description: The promo banner headline '3 free deliveries for you' and the subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' are white on a very light mint background. The contrast is extremely low and the text is barely legible. The promo code is the key information in the banner.
issues.suggestion: Use dark text or a darker, saturated banner background so contrast meets WCAG AA (4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text). Make the promo code stand out.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the time pill on the first card (15–25 min) overlaps and hides part of the bowl image. Its position also looks inconsistent with the image content on the other cards.
issues.suggestion: Anchor the time badges consistently at the bottom-left of the card with uniform padding, and make sure they do not cover the key part of the image.

issues.description: The first 'Fastest near you' card has a pale, washed-out background, while the other cards are dark. This makes the card set look visually inconsistent. The dish image also looks small and low-fidelity relative to its card.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent image treatment, cropping and scale across cards, for example a uniform overlay or photo style.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) icon on the '-20%' pizza card sits on a semi-transparent dark circle over a busy image. The white heart has weak separation there. The gray inactive tab labels (Search, Orders, Profile) are also low-contrast.
issues.suggestion: Use a more opaque background behind the favorite icon and darken the inactive tab label and icon color to improve contrast.
